plugins.name: dutch-cultural-heritage-collections
plugins.description: Dutch cultural heritage collections: search and read digitised Dutch heritage sources. First service: Delpher (Koninklijke Bibliotheek, National Library of the Netherlands) - search digitised newspapers (1618-1995), magazines, books and ANP radio bulletins, read the full OCR text and count hits over time. More collections (such as the Amsterdam City Archives image bank) will follow.
